description: This file defines the ProjectSecurityData class, which calculates and provides security coverage information for Drupal core, including constants for coverage end dates, methods to determine coverage until specific versions, and handling of release data.

classes.name: ProjectSecurityData
classes.description: Final class that manages security coverage calculations for Drupal core, including constants for coverage dates, methods to determine coverage until specific versions, and handling release data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor initializing existing version and releases.

methods.name: createFromProjectDataAndReleases
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance from project data and release info, only for Drupal core.

methods.name: getCoverageInfo
methods.description: Returns security coverage details based on installed version and release data, either as date-based or version-based coverage info.

methods.name: getSecurityCoverageUntilVersion
methods.description: Determines the next version until which the current version is covered for security, based on release cycle.

methods.name: getAdditionalSecurityCoveredMinors
methods.description: Calculates how many minor versions beyond the current are still covered for security.

methods.name: getSemanticMinorVersion
methods.description: Extracts the minor version number from a semantic version string.
